population: Global AI/ML/Data salary records; not Vietnam monthly job offers
cleaning: Keep finite annual USD salary 1000..1000000; work_year 2020..2025; remote_ratio 0/50/100; drop exact complete-record duplicates; required categorical fields nonempty. Fixed before fitting.
split: GroupShuffleSplit seed20261018:20% test, then18.75% of remainder validation; identical feature profile across years kept in one partition. No respondent/company identity exists; cannot guarantee person/company-disjoint split.
selection: Per-family minimum validation MAE, RMSE tie break; choose family by same rule. Test both selected families and train-median baseline once after selection.
promotion: Research-only global benchmark; never replace Vietnam offer model or Gemma. No ITviec input or alignment gate.
limits: Self-reported anonymous data, not human-gold verification
A categorical experience level is not numeric years of experience
No technology skills columns; do not claim skill income effects
Random profile-group holdout is not temporal validation
Country and year selection bias; raw record count is not independent people
